list.name: network
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT network FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity ORDER BY network

panels.title: Hosting Capacity by Method (latest run)
panels.description: Side-by-side comparison of the three methodologies for the selected network. Read the stochastic row's numbers with care: at the default Monte Carlo sampling range, they are a lower bound under an arbitrary PV-size budget, not yet a ceiling comparable to the deterministic/QSTS results -- see hosting_capacity/stochastic.py's module docstring. Recalibration is deferred to Phase 8 (real PV-sizing data), not fixed yet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (method) method, run_timestamp, total_pv_mw_comparable, total_pv_mw_p95, lambda_max, binding_constraint, violation_rate, n_trials FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity WHERE network = '$network' ORDER BY method, run_timestamp DESC

panels.title: Total PV Hosting Capacity — Comparable Number (MW)
panels.description: deterministic/qsts: total PV at the binding constraint. stochastic: p50 of feasible trials — NOT yet calibrated to the same ceiling, see panel above.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (method) method AS metric, total_pv_mw_comparable AS value FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity WHERE network = '$network' ORDER BY method, run_timestamp DESC

panels.title: Binding Constraint (deterministic / QSTS)
panels.description: Which element (voltage, line, or transformer) limited hosting capacity first, per method. Non-convergence shows as 'power_flow_non_convergence' rather than a physical element.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (method) method, lambda_max, binding_constraint FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity WHERE network = '$network' AND method IN ('deterministic', 'qsts') ORDER BY method, run_timestamp DESC
